1263-2324-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1263-2324-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Proper Burial and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

618-5887-6495.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Werefox Bodyguard.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the Werefox Bodyguard token.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
618-5887-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

728-1981-2415-3188.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
728-1981-2415-3188.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

2919-3188-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3188-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

4694-6798-7652.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Tom, Bert, and William.
When Tom, Bert, and William die, they trigger, returning them from your graveyard to the battlefield as a noncreature artifact.
Because Tom, Bert, and William enter as a noncreature artifact, March of the Machines will then cause Tom, Bert, and William to be a 5/5 artifact creature.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

5686-6461--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Warden of the Grove triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2180-2921-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Nearheath Stalker
When Nearheath Stalker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Nearheath Stalker
When Nearheath Stalker dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Nearheath Stalker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
2180-2921-6972.notes: If Nearheath Stalker starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

5089-5540-7512.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause an artifact, creature, or enchantment to enter the battlefield.
An opponent controls an artifact.
If you are going to have a nonartifact creature or enchantment enter the battlefield, an opponent must also control either a creature or enchantment respectively.
5089-5540-7512.description:
Cause an artifact, creature or enchantment to enter the battlefield.
Confusion in the Ranks triggers, exchanging control of the permanent that entered with an opponent for another permanent of the same type.
Zidane triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Confusion in the Ranks triggers, exchanging control of the Treasure with an opponent for another artifact.
Repeat from step 3.
5089-5540-7512.notes: Karn, the Great Creator prevents the opponents from sacrificing the Treasures for mana. Without it, your opponents can sacrifice the Treasures and stop you (eventually) from exchanging control of artifacts.

2034-4215-5497.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken green creature.
2034-4215-5497.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a nontoken green creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hoverstone Pilgrim by paying {2}, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the green creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2011-3259-3480.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2011-3259-3480.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Najeela as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
2011-3259-3480.notes: Najeela can make additional Warriors if you attack with multiple each iteration. Najeela doesn't have to attack after the first iteration, as the Warrior token will trigger it.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3480-7279.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3480-7279.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker.
Razorkin Hordecaller triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7159.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Arcbound Tracker.
When Arcbound Tracker dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Tracker's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Tracker from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

851-4571-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
851-4571-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Life // Death
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is not attached to a creature

5479-5963-6877--60.easyPrerequisites: You are able to animate the land.
5479-5963-6877--60.notablePrerequisites: Synthesizer Labship has nine or more charge counters on it.
5479-5963-6877--60.description:
Animate the land, if needed.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Synthesizer Labship triggers, animating Lost Jitte.
Activate Marvin using Synthesizer Labship's station ability by tapping the animated land, putting a number of charge counters on Marvin equal to the animated land's power.
Activate Marvin using Lost Jitte's ability by removing a charge counter from it, untapping the animated land.
Repeat from step 3.
5479-5963-6877--60.notes: The animated land needs to have power 2 or greater for the combo to net results.

4613-4968-6260-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Caradora.
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

725-5479-6702.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Kilo.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a charge counter on Lost Jitte.
Resolve the Aura of Dominion ability, untapping Kilo.
Activate Lost Jitte by removing a charge counter from it, untapping a land.
Repeat.

4050-4484-5643-6556.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
4050-4484-5643-6556.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
4050-4484-5643-6556.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
4050-4484-5643-6556.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1-2498-5636-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-2498-5636-6282.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability.
Repeat.

1789-2292-4875-5649.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
1789-2292-4875-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5256-5434-5541-5555.notablePrerequisites:
Bazaar Trader does not have summoning sickness.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
5256-5434-5541-5555.description:
Activate Bazaar Trader by tapping it, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2054-2440-4183-4730.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Sparring Mummy
2054-2440-4183-4730.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sparring Mummy with haste.
When the token Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Sparring Mummy trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Sparring Mummy, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Sparring Mummy for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Urn of Godfire twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

1090-2034-6132.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Restoration Angel.
1090-2034-6132.description:
Cast Restoration Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Restoration Angel.
Resolve the Restoration Angel ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Restoration Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4200-5147-6132.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Icewind Stalwart.
4200-5147-6132.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

5941-5959.manaNeeded: {2}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional sorcery
5941-5959.notablePrerequisites:
You have not cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
You have a sorcery card in hand.
5941-5959.description:
Cast the additional sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Alania triggers; choose not to have an opponent draw a card.
Holding priority, cast Wild Ricochet by paying {2}{R}{R}, targeting the additional sorcery.
Alania triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card and you to copy Wild Ricochet, with the copy targeting the original Wild Ricochet.
Resolve the copy of Wild Ricochet, copying the original Wild Ricochet, with the copy targeting the original Wild Ricochet.
Repeat step 5.

2438-2486--5.notablePrerequisites:
The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
You control your commander.
2438-2486--5.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to your commander's ability granted to it by Master Chef.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

38-1012-5220.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Skirk Prospector on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying {R}.
Repeat.

3552-4289-4893-5153.notablePrerequisites: Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
3552-4289-4893-5153.description:
Tap Sunstrike Legionnaire to add {W}.
Pay {W} to create a 1/1 Warrior token.
Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

2645-2919-4017-4929.notablePrerequisites:
Sunbond attached to Cryptic Trilobite.
Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter.
2645-2919-4017-4929.description:
Activate Staff of Domination's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, gaining you 1 life.
Archangel of Thune and Sunbond triggers.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing two +1/+1 counters, adding {4}.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
